body_lead: Gandhinagar : Gujarat govt has rolled out a statewide GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) framework to provide computing resources to departments, public institutions and select artificial intelligence startups. The framework is effective immediately, govt said. Approved under the stateâs AI action plan, the framework will create a pool of graphics processing unit infrastructure for eligible entities working on approved AI and data-driven projects. Gujarat Informatics Ltd (GIL) will manage the system, including provisioning, operations, monitoring and administration.
